top_10_facts.fact: Broadcom reported third quarter fiscal year 2026 revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86 percent from the prior year period.
Broadcom reported GAAP operating income of $16.0 billion and Non-GAAP operating income of $20.1 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
Broadcom reported GAAP diluted EPS of $2.68 and Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.32 for the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
Broadcom generated cash from operations of $14.2 billion in the third quarter, less capital expenditures of $0.5 billion, resulting in $13.7 billion of free cash flow, or 46 percent of revenue.
Broadcom declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.65 per share.
Broadcom guided fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 revenue to approximately $34.8 billion, an increase of 93 percent from the prior year period.
Broadcom guided fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 Non-GAAP operating income to approximately 66 percent of projected revenue.
Broadcom commenced cash tender offers on June 11, 2026 to purchase certain outstanding notes up to an aggregate purchase price of $2.5 billion.
Broadcom announced pricing terms of its cash tender offers on June 17, 2026, for notes up to an aggregate purchase price of $2.5 billion.
Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said on September 14, 2026 that the company stands by its long-term revenue targets despite concerns about a potential slowdown in frontier AI model development.
